title: Safe Deposit Boxes: Drilling Notices, Forced Opening and Held Contents
content:
Under the Safe Deposit Boxes terms, long-unpaid rent on a box can end with the bank opening the box by force. This policy describes the notice that must go out, the waiting period that follows it, how the opening itself is carried out, and what becomes of the contents afterwards.

## Terms by box size

| Box size | Rent unpaid this many days after the due date | Notice method | Days from notice to earliest drilling | Months contents are held | Fee to retrieve held contents (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | 120 | Certified mail | 30 | 12 | 50.00 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | 120 | Certified mail | 30 | 12 | 50.00 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | 120 | Certified mail | 30 | 12 | 50.00 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | 120 | Certified mail | 30 | 12 | 50.00 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | 120 | Certified mail | 30 | 12 | 50.00 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | 120 | Certified mail | 30 | 12 | 50.00 |

## The drilling notice

When a rental's rent is still unpaid 120 days after its rent due date, the bank mails a drilling notice by certified mail to the lessee's address on file, and the rental passes from past due to drill pending. The date the notice was mailed is kept on the rental record.

## Waiting period before the box is opened

A drill pending box may not be opened until 30 calendar days have run from the mailing. Day 1 is the day after the notice date. Drilling becomes permissible on the notice date advanced by 30 days and on any later date, and not earlier. The mailing date held in the rental record governs this count.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical notice mailed on 1 September):**

| Proposed drilling date | Days run since the mailing | Permitted? |
|---|---|---|
| 29 September | 28 | No |
| 30 September | 29 | No |
| 1 October | 30 | Yes |
| 2 October | 31 | Yes |

## Settling up while drill pending

If everything owed on the rental is paid before the drilling date, the rental goes back to active.

## The forced opening

The box is drilled under dual control, with a witness present. Its contents are listed in an inventory and sealed, the drilling fee for the size is charged to the rental as a drilling service charge on the drilling date, and the lease comes to an end, closing the rental.

## Contents after drilling

The sealed contents are kept for 12 months. During that time the former lessee may reclaim them by paying everything owed on the rental together with the retrieval fee of 50.00. Contents not reclaimed within the 12 months are reported to the state unclaimed property program; what happens under that program lies outside this policy.
